meaning: Executable witnesses for complete problems in the 100-question domain catalog.

cases.question: Are degenerate projectors gauge safe, does the DOS obey state counting, and does an open-system interior LDOS approach the Bloch result?
cases.oracle: projector invariance, normalized spectral weight, and decreasing open-to-Bloch LDOS error

cases.question: Are Peierls gauges unitarily equivalent, do magnetic translations carry the flux phase, and does the lowest one-third-flux band satisfy the Diophantine Chern label?
cases.oracle: diagonal gauge equivalence, magnetic-translation algebra, q magnetic bands, and Chern magnitude one

cases.question: Does a declared Nambu convention enforce particle-hole symmetry, recover the short-junction Andreev spectrum, and distinguish topological Majorana end modes from trivial near-zero controls?
cases.oracle: particle-hole residual, analytic Andreev levels and current, Kitaev invariant, end localization, and exponential splitting

cases.question: Do periodic lead modes, velocities, surface self-energies, and evanescent decay agree with the analytic nearest-neighbor chain?
cases.oracle: analytic mode count, group velocity, retarded chain self-energy, and subunit evanescent factor

not_applicable.pythtb: PythTB has no semi-infinite lead-mode or retarded self-energy solver.

cases.question: Does a spinful lattice preserve the skyrmion charge and spectrum under a common rigid spin rotation when spin-orbit coupling is absent?
cases.oracle: converged discrete texture charge and unitary spectral covariance

cases.question: Does one non-orthogonal model recipe preserve its basis, low-energy subspace, truncation convergence, symmetries, and held-out strain transfer?
cases.oracle: positive overlap metric, real generalized spectrum, projector fidelity, monotone truncation, linear symmetry breaking, and bounded held-out error

cases.question: Does the square-lattice band expose its van Hove saddle and the associated Lifshitz state-counting transition?
cases.oracle: zero-energy mixed-sign Hessian and half-filled, refinement-stable state count at the Lifshitz energy

cases.question: Do Harper spectra approach the low-flux Landau fan and stable irrational-flux observables along independent rational sequences?
cases.oracle: monotone sub-percent Landau error and sequence-independent integrated density of states

cases.question: Are bulk indices gauge safe, phase boundaries localized, nested Wilson flows stable, and trivial controls rejected?
cases.oracle: gauge-invariant integer indices, analytic QWZ critical mass, quantized nested polarization, and zero atomic Chern number

cases.question: Do finite terminations, surface Green functions, protected flow, and finite geometry families give mutually consistent boundary conclusions?
cases.oracle: analytic termination signatures, finite-surface agreement, protected chiral flow, and stable localized boundary observables

cases.question: Are geometric tensors gauge covariant and do symmetry-resolved nonlinear responses remain consistent from bulk to finite and lead-attached forms?
cases.oracle: unitary-invariant quantum tensor, symmetry-forbidden zero, odd finite tilt response, zero Chern, and finite boundary/device observables

cases.question: Does a declared seed exactly replay Hermitian and non-Hermitian disorder ensembles with the requested moments and correlations?
cases.oracle: byte-identical replay, distinct independent seed, three-standard-error distribution gates, and finite complex spectrum

cases.question: Does one open-system stack conserve current, reproduce analytic transmission and noise, remain stable for evanescent devices, and transfer across contacts?
cases.oracle: unitarity and continuity, resonant-level and partition-noise limits, stable exponential decay, and reciprocal contact families

cases.question: Does a continuum kinetic operator converge under Thouless finite-difference discretization while retaining the declared BdG particle-hole symmetry?
cases.oracle: second-order continuum eigenvalue convergence and machine-precision particle-hole covariance

cases.question: Do dense non-Hermitian solvers resolve biorthogonality, exceptional branching, non-Bloch skin localization, and distinct gain-loss families?
cases.oracle: small left/right residuals, square-root exceptional exponent, analytic open spectrum with localization reversal, and correct PT regimes

cases.question: Does a large periodic geometry close exactly and do geometry-dependent couplings remain smooth and rotation covariant?
cases.oracle: exact graph counts and closure, invariant rotated distance, monotone coupling decay, and correct strain derivative

cases.question: Do spin-current and torque continuity, Hall-mechanism controls, texture refinement, and magnetic-family observables share one consistent convention?
cases.oracle: commutator-level continuity, symmetry-resolved Hall response, monotone adiabatic approach, and valid common observables across four textures

cases.question: Are dense and sparse response operators identical, thermoelectric limits reciprocal, and KPM accurate from exact overlap to large sparse scale?
cases.oracle: velocity-operator identity, zero thermopower and Wiedemann-Franz limit, exact KPM moment overlap, spectral sum rule, and sparse storage

cases.question: Can a translation-free graph preserve connectivity and metric invariants under relabelling and rigid motion?
cases.oracle: exact path-graph counts and degree histogram plus machine-precision rigid-motion distances

cases.question: Does one defect recipe preserve provenance, local chemistry, embedding convergence, spectral-transport consistency, and sparse family sum rules?
cases.oracle: exact provenance, chemically shifted resonance, embedding-supercell agreement, finite local state with suppressed transmission, and unit local spectral weight

cases.question: Can continuum and lattice descriptions be mapped, compared through gauge-invariant observables, decomposed by error source, and frozen before an external-family check?
cases.oracle: small shared-regime error, exact round trip, invariant spectra and projectors, bounding error budget, and unchanged external tolerance

cases.question: Can sparse numerical errors be separated while fixed-accuracy KPM scales to one million states and exactly replays a dense-to-production recipe?
cases.oracle: covered error budget, fixed KPM sum-rule accuracy with linear storage and fitted timing interval, plus exact dense-sparse seeded overlap
